answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the mirror index resolves every citation against the signal checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the crystal audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 53 aliases hence pays the authoring cost 53 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. That is 40 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
